description: This file defines an interface ILifecycleObserver within the Orleans namespace, which declares methods for handling lifecycle start and stop events asynchronously.

classes.name: ILifecycleObserver
classes.description: Interface for lifecycle observers to handle start and stop notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles the start event notification asynchronously, accepting an optional CancellationToken.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles the stop event notification asynchronously, accepting an optional CancellationToken.
